caption: The drawing features a single object positioned centrally on a plain beige background framed by a thin rectangular outline. The object is a jointed, wooden figure resembling a human form, painted in dark tones of black and deep brown, with slightly lighter or reflective areas suggesting highlights. The figure has articulated limbs with visible joints at the shoulders, elbows, hips, and knees. It wears a small, flat-brimmed hat, colored in similar dark brown hues with some reddish-brown accents and a lighter brown hatband. The face of the figure has carved, simple features including almond-shaped eyes, a straight nose, and a closed mouth with lips highlighted in a reddish tone. The figure's hands are minimally detailed, and its feet are also simply shaped, both colored to match the rest of the body. The background is unadorned, and no other objects or decorations are present in the drawing. In the lower left corner of the border, the name "Miya Lowry" is written in small, neat letters.
title: Dancing Doll
